query:
-- Create default staff departments for each organization
INSERT INTO staffDepartments (organizationId, name, description, createdBy, updatedBy)
SELECT 
  g.id as organizationId,
  CONCAT(g.name, ' Department') as name,
  CONCAT('Default department for ', g.name) as description,
  g.createdBy,
  g.updatedBy
FROM groups g;

-- Update teams to reference their organization's department
UPDATE teams t
INNER JOIN staffDepartments sd ON sd.organizationId = t.groupId
SET t.staffDepartmentId = sd.id;

-- Verify the migration
SELECT 
  'Organizations' as entity, COUNT(*) as count FROM groups
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Staff Departments', COUNT(*) FROM staffDepartments
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Teams', COUNT(*) FROM teams
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Teams with staffDepartmentId', COUNT(*) FROM teams WHERE staffDepartmentId IS NOT NULL;
